description: Two oscillators built from a 32-bit seed, one stepping through a bit pattern and one through a note sequence, each filtered by its own modulation shapes

params.text: Sets how fast the modulation shapes run, in nine steps from a hundredth of their built-in rate to eight times it

inputs.text: A rising edge here picks a new random seed, and the sound fades out and back in on the new one
A cable here gates the module: the output is 0V whenever this input is at 0V, and the sound runs whenever it is above that

notes: the seed is set with the grid of 32 buttons, each one a bit of the seed, and the Random button rolls a new one
a new module picks a random seed for itself and sounds as soon as it is added; nothing has to be patched to it

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
